description: MATSim Open Berlin provides a maintained open MATSim transport scenario for Berlin with calibrated population samples. The provider is TU Berlin, Transport Systems Planning and Transport Telematics. Geographical and temporal coverage: The repository documents 10 percent, 3 percent and 1 percent samples of Greater Berlin with scaled road capacities. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is GPL-2.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The model is a sampled and calibrated scenario, not a full observed population. Select one consistent release and scale. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-matsim, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
